features.title: Sign in to Ardur
features.summary: Use the email form, recognize a connection failure, and open password recovery when available.

steps.text: Open the sign-in page and find the email form.
steps.expected: The email form is ready.

steps.text: Submit the email form while the server cannot be reached.
steps.expected: The form shows a server connection error.

steps.text: Choose password recovery from the sign-in page.

features.title: Integrations
features.summary: Find an integration, review pending tools, save explicit permissions, and open a connection form.

steps.text: Open Settings, then Integrations, and find a catalog entry.
steps.expected: The integration table appears.

steps.text: Open Manage and inspect the read tool permission.
steps.expected: The read tool permission is Ask.

steps.text: Change the read tool permission to Allow.
steps.expected: The read tool shows Allow.

steps.text: Change the read tool permission to Block, then choose Save.
steps.expected: The saved read tool permission is Block.

steps.text: Choose Back, reopen Manage to confirm Block persisted, then choose Back and open Use a token for another integration.
steps.expected: The token entry field appears.

boundaries: Opening a connection form does not connect an account.
Permission changes take effect only after Save; Block removes tool access, and write tools remain subject to their approval policy.
On mobile, a connected integration opens Manage on web; tool permissions are changed in the web or desktop app.
Connected describes account access, not permission to use tools. Empty or pending tool permissions show Connected · tools need review.
Choose Review tools from Context or a bot access row, check the marked read-only selection, then choose Allow selected or Allow all. Opening review does not grant access.
Bot permissions stay within the space tool list unless an owner explicitly also allows the selection for the space. Reopen a review if the available tools change.
Phone Context shows pending tool review and offers Review tools on web; tool selection remains in web or desktop.

troubleshooting.message: Could not save or load access.
troubleshooting.action: Choose Try again to reload access, then set the permission and choose Save again.
